description: A 16-step drum machine with synthesized kick, snare, hat and clap plus BPM control.

faqs.a: All sounds are synthesized live with Web Audio oscillators and filtered noise — no samples or downloads.
faqs.q: Are the drum sounds real samples?

faqs.a: Click steps to toggle them; the four rows are kick, snare, hi-hat and clap.
faqs.q: How do I program a beat?

faqs.a: From 60 to 200 BPM with the tempo slider.

howto: Set the BPM with the tempo slider.
Press Play to hear your beat.
title: Drum Machine
